summary: Many characters differ by one stroke or one radical, and a slip turns one word into another: 已经 is not 自己, 周末 is not 未来. The idea that makes it click: the radical (the left or top part) carries the meaning, so ask what the word is about. Eyes take 目 (眼睛), the sun takes 日 (晴天), water takes 氵 (清楚), speech takes 讠 (请). Where no radical differs, learn the one stroke that differs as a picture: a crow 乌 has no eye.

subs.label: Open or closed, long or short stroke
subs.focus: 己 / 已 / 巳, 未 / 末, 土 / 士, 干 / 千 / 于, 午 / 牛. Items test 自己 vs 已经, 周末 vs 未来, 护士, 干净 / 一千 / 终于, 下午 vs 牛奶. Typical error: 己经 for 已经, 周未 for 周末.

subs.label: Strokes added to 人, 大 and 日
subs.focus: 人 / 入 / 八, 大 / 太 / 犬 / 天 / 夫, 日 / 目 / 白 / 自. Items test 入口, 太热, 今天, 丈夫, 生日, 题目, 明白, 自己. Typical error: 人口 for 入口, 大热了 for 太热了, 目己 for 自己.

subs.label: One dot or piece more
subs.focus: 买 / 卖, 我 / 找, 牛 / 半, 刀 / 力, 鸟 / 乌, 贝 / 见, 今 / 令. Items test buy vs sell (the sentence must force which), 找东西, 七点半, 努力, 小鸟 vs 乌云, 再见, 今天 vs 令人. Typical error: 卖 for 买, 我 for 找.

subs.label: Families of 青 and 主
subs.focus: 请 / 清 / 情 / 晴 / 睛 / 精 and 住 / 往 / 注 / 主. Items test the radical chosen by meaning: 请问, 清楚, 心情, 晴天, 眼睛, 精彩; 住在, 往前走, 注意, 主要. Typical error: 眼晴 for 眼睛, 住前走 for 往前走.

subs.label: Same right part, radical decides
subs.focus: 他 / 她 / 它 / 地 / 池, 那 / 哪, 很 / 根 / 跟 / 狠, 喝 / 渴, 快 / 块 / 筷, 蓝 / 篮. Items test the meaning radical: 她 for a woman, 哪 in questions, 跟 for 'with', 渴 for thirst, 一块钱, 筷子, 篮球. Typical error: 那国人 for 哪国人, 渴水 for 喝水.

subs.label: What sits inside or below
subs.focus: 问 / 间 / 闻 / 们 / 闪, 休 / 体, 洒 / 酒, 泪 / 汨, 爱 / 受, 外 / 处, 乐 / 东 / 车. Items test 问题, 时间, 新闻, 我们, 休息, 身体, 喝酒, 眼泪, 难受, 外面, 好处, 快乐, 东西, 汽车. Typical error: 体息 for 休息, 喝洒 for 喝酒.

subs.label: HSK 4 pairs split by radical
subs.focus: 拔 / 拨, 辩 / 辨 / 辫, 练 / 炼, 历 / 厉, 候 / 侯. Items test 锻炼 vs 练习, 辩论 vs 分辨 vs 辫子, 历史 vs 厉害, 时候, 拔牙 vs 拨电话. Typical error: 锻练 for 锻炼, 历害 for 厉害, 时侯 for 时候.

subs.label: HSK 4 pairs fixed by the word
subs.focus: 既 / 即, 竟 / 竞, 须 / 需, 象 / 像 / 向. Items test 既然 vs 立即, 竟然 vs 竞争, 必须 vs 需要, 好像 / 像 vs 大象 / 印象 vs 方向 / 向. Typical error: 竞然 for 竟然, 必需 for 必须 before a verb, 好象 for 好像.

rules.rule: 己 jǐ (self) is open at the top left, 已 yǐ (already) is half closed, 巳 sì is fully closed. 末 mò (end) and 士 shì have the long line on top; 未 wèi (not yet) and 土 tǔ have it at the bottom.
rules.pattern: 自己 · 已经 · 周末 · 未来 · 护士 · 土豆

examples.py: wǒ zì jǐ zuò fàn
tā yǐ jīng zǒu le
zhè ge zhōu mò nǐ máng ma
tā shì yī wèi hù shi

rules.note: Rhyme: 己 open, 已 half, 巳 full. 巳 is almost never in HSK words; if you think you need it, you want 已. 末 is a tree 木 with its tip marked by the long top line: the end. 土 is the wide ground at the bottom.

rules.rule: 干 gān has two flat lines and a straight stroke down; 千 qiān starts with a slanted stroke on top; 于 yú ends in a hook. 午 wǔ stops at the top line; 牛 niú pokes through it, like a horn.
rules.pattern: 干净 · 一千 · 终于 · 关于 · 下午 · 牛奶

examples.py: fáng jiān hěn gān jìng
tā zhōng yú lái le
wǒ men xià wǔ jiàn
wǒ měi tiān hē niú nǎi

rules.note: At this level 千 means 'thousand' (一千, 两千). 于 is in 终于, 关于, 对于, 由于. 干 is in 干净 and 干什么 (gàn).

rules.rule: 人 rén leans on its long left stroke, 入 rù (enter) on its long right one; 八 bā's strokes do not touch. 大 plus a top line is 天; plus a dot below is 太. 夫 has two lines and its slant pokes out above both.
rules.pattern: 入口 · 今天 · 太好了 · 丈夫 · 生日 · 题目 · 明白 · 自己

examples.py: rù kǒu zài nǎ r
jīn tiān tài rè le
tā zhàng fu shì yī shēng
zhè ge tí mù hěn nán

rules.note: 日 rì (sun, day) has one line inside, 目 mù (eye) two and is taller. A dot on top turns 日 into 白 (明白, 白色) and 目 into 自 (自己). 犬 quǎn (dog) has its dot at the top right; it is rare at HSK 1 to 4.

rules.rule: One extra piece flips the word. 卖 mài (sell) is 买 mǎi (buy) with 十 on top. 找 zhǎo has a plain hand 扌; 我 adds a slant on top of it. 力 lì pokes above its top line, 刀 dāo does not. 鸟 niǎo has an eye dot, 乌 wū none.
rules.pattern: 买东西 · 卖菜 · 找手机 · 努力 · 一把刀 · 小鸟 · 乌云

examples.py: tā zài shì chǎng mài cài
examples.en: He sells vegetables at the market.

examples.py: wǒ zài zhǎo wǒ de shǒu jī
tā xué xí hěn nǔ lì
tiān shàng yǒu hěn duō wū yún
examples.en: There are a lot of dark clouds in the sky.

rules.note: 多了就卖，少了就买: with more on top (十) you sell. The crow is black, so you cannot see its eye. 半 bàn (half) has two dots on top, 牛 one slanted stroke. 见 jiàn ends in a hooked foot, 贝 bèi in a dot. 今 jīn (今天) ends like a 7, 令 lìng (令人) in 卩.

rules.rule: 青 gives the sound qing or jing; the radical gives the meaning: 讠 speech 请 (please, invite), 氵 water 清 (clear), 忄 heart 情 (feeling), 日 sun 晴 (sunny), 目 eye 睛 (eye), 米 rice 精 (refined; 精彩 brilliant).
rules.pattern: 请 · 清楚 · 心情 · 晴天 · 眼睛 · 精彩

examples.py: wǒ qǐng nǐ hē chá
jīn tiān shì qíng tiān
tā de yǎn jing hěn dà
wǒ tīng bù qīng chu

rules.note: 情 and 晴 are both qíng, 睛 and 精 both jīng, so the sound will not save you; only the meaning will. Weather is the sun: 晴. Eyes are the eye: 睛.

rules.rule: 主 is the base. With 亻 person: 住 zhù (live, stay). With 彳 step: 往 wǎng (toward). With 氵 water: 注 zhù (pour, as in 注意). Alone: 主 zhǔ (主要, 主意).
rules.pattern: 住在 · 往前走 · 注意 · 主要 · 主意

examples.py: wǒ zhù zài běi jīng
wǎng zuǒ guǎi jiù dào le
guò mǎ lù yào zhù yì ān quán
examples.en: Be careful when you cross the road.

examples.py: zhè shì wǒ de zhǔ yi

rules.note: 住 and 往 differ only on the left: 亻 has one slanted stroke, 彳 two. A person lives somewhere (住); steps go somewhere (往). 住 and 注 sound the same, zhù: 注意 is attention poured like water.

rules.rule: The left part tells the meaning: 他 (he) person 亻, 她 (she) woman 女, 它 (it) for animals and things, 地 (ground; de before a verb) earth 土, 池 (pool) water 氵. 哪 nǎ (which) is 那 nà (that) plus an asking mouth 口.
rules.pattern: 他 · 她 · 它 · 高兴地 · 游泳池 · 那儿 / 哪儿

examples.zh: 我家有一只狗，它很可爱。
examples.py: wǒ jiā yǒu yī zhī gǒu tā hěn kě ài
examples.en: We have a dog at home; it's very cute.

examples.py: tā gāo xìng de xiào le
nǐ zhù zài nǎ r
wǒ men qù yóu yǒng chí yóu yǒng ba
examples.en: Let's go swimming at the pool.

rules.note: 他, 她 and 它 all sound tā; only the English cue (he, she, it) decides. In a question asking which or where, write 哪; when pointing (that, there), write 那.

rules.rule: Same right part, the radical decides: 跟 gēn (with, follow) has a foot, 根 gēn (root; measure for sticks) wood 木, 很 hěn (very) the step 彳, 狠 hěn (ruthless) the animal 犭. 喝 hē (drink) has a mouth, 渴 kě (thirsty) water.
rules.pattern: 跟 · 一根 · 很好 · 喝水 · 口渴 · 一块钱 · 筷子 · 篮球

examples.py: wǒ gēn mā ma qù chāo shì
examples.en: I'm going to the supermarket with Mum.

examples.zh: 他口渴了，喝了一大杯水。
examples.py: tā kǒu kě le hē le yī dà bēi shuǐ
examples.en: He was thirsty and drank a big glass of water.

examples.py: wǒ yòng kuài zi chī fàn
wǒ xǐ huan dǎ lán qiú

rules.note: 快 kuài (fast, happy) has the heart 忄, 块 kuài (piece; yuan) earth 土, 筷 kuài (chopstick) bamboo on top. 蓝 lán (blue) has grass 艹, from a dye plant; 篮 lán (basket) has bamboo: a basket is woven from bamboo.

rules.rule: What sits inside 门 decides: mouth 口 问 wèn (ask), sun 日 间 jiān (time, room), ear 耳 闻 wén (news, smell), person 人 闪 shǎn (flash). 们 men has 亻 beside 门. 休 xiū (rest) is 亻+木, 体 tǐ (body) 亻+本.
rules.pattern: 问题 · 时间 · 房间 · 新闻 · 我们 · 休息 · 身体

examples.zh: 我可以问你一个问题吗？
examples.py: wǒ kě yǐ wèn nǐ yī ge wèn tí ma
examples.en: Can I ask you a question?

examples.py: nǐ yǒu shí jiān ma
wǒ měi tiān kàn xīn wén
examples.en: I watch the news every day.

examples.py: tā shēn tǐ hěn hǎo

rules.note: A mouth at the door asks (问); sunlight through the door gap is a space or a stretch of time (间); an ear at the door hears (闻). A person leaning on a tree 木 rests (休); 体 has the extra line of 本.

rules.rule: Small inner differences: 酒 jiǔ (alcohol) has 酉, a jar with an extra line inside; 洒 sǎ (sprinkle) only 西. 泪 lèi (tears) is water from the eye 目; 汨 has 日. 爱 ài (love) has 友 at the bottom, 受 shòu (bear, receive) only 又.
rules.pattern: 喝酒 · 眼泪 · 爱 · 难受 · 外面 · 好处 · 快乐 · 东西 · 汽车

examples.py: bà ba bù hē jiǔ
tā liú xià le yǎn lèi
wǒ ài wǒ de jiā
xué hàn yǔ yǒu hěn duō hǎo chù

rules.note: 外 wài starts with 夕; 处 chù starts with 夂, whose long sweep runs under 卜. 乐 lè starts with a slanted stroke, 东 dōng with a flat line; both have two small feet. 车 chē has no feet and a line at the bottom. 汨 mì is only in the river name 汨罗.

rules.rule: Same sound, the radical gives the meaning. 炼 liàn has fire 火 (锻炼, work out), 练 liàn silk 纟 (练习, practise). 辩 biàn has speech 讠 (辩论, debate), 辨 a dot and slash like a knife (分辨, tell apart), 辫 silk 纟 (辫子, braid).
rules.pattern: 锻炼 · 练习 · 辩论 · 分辨 · 厉害 · 历史 · 时候

examples.py: wǒ měi tiān zǎo shang duàn liàn shēn tǐ
tā de hàn yǔ hěn lì hai
tā men zài biàn lùn zhè ge wèn tí
nǐ shén me shí hou huí lái

rules.note: 历 lì (历史, 经历) has 力 under 厂; 厉 lì (厉害) has 万. 拔 bá (pull out: 拔牙) differs from 拨 bō (dial, push aside), whose right side is 发. 候 hòu (时候, 问候) has a short vertical after 亻 that 侯 hóu, a surname, lacks.

rules.rule: 必须 xū (must) has hair 彡 and head 页; 需要 xū (need) has rain 雨 on top. 竟然 jìng has 音 over 儿; 竞争 jìng has 立 over 兄. 像 xiàng (resemble, seem) has a person 亻; 象 is the elephant; 向 means toward.
rules.pattern: 必须 · 需要 · 竟然 · 竞争 · 好像 · 大象 · 方向

examples.py: wǒ men bì xū mǎ shàng chū fā
examples.en: We must set off right away.

examples.py: nǐ xū yào bāng máng ma
tā jìng rán wàng le wǒ de shēng rì
tā zhǎng de hěn xiàng tā mā ma
examples.en: She looks a lot like her mother.

rules.note: 象 also writes the 'image' words 印象, 现象, 形象. 必需 (necessary: 必需品) exists, but 'must' before a verb is 必须. 既 jì (既然) ends in 旡: the eater has turned away, done. 即 jí (立即, 即使) ends in 卩: kneeling to eat now.

right.py: wǒ yǐ jīng chī fàn le

contrasts.why: 已经 (already) needs 已, whose left stroke rises halfway. 己 (fully open) is 'self', as in 自己.

right.py: zhè ge zhōu mò nǐ yǒu kòng ma

contrasts.why: 周末 is the end of the week: 末 has the long line on top, the tip of the tree. 未 (short top line) means 'not yet', as in 未来.
A question about which needs 哪 nǎ, with the asking mouth 口. 那 nà only points: that.

right.py: tā de yǎn jing hěn piào liang

contrasts.why: 眼睛 is about eyes, so it takes the eye radical 目: 睛. 晴 with the sun 日 is sunny weather, as in 晴天.

right.py: wǒ kě le xiǎng hē shuǐ
right.en: I'm thirsty; I want to drink some water.

contrasts.why: Drinking is done with the mouth: 喝 has 口. 渴 with water 氵 is the feeling of thirst.

right.py: nǐ lèi le jiù xiū xi yī xià ba
right.en: If you're tired, take a rest.

contrasts.why: 休息 is a person 亻 leaning on a tree 木: 休. 体 (亻 + 本, with an extra line) is the body, as in 身体.

right.py: yī zhí wǎng qián zǒu jiù dào le
right.en: Go straight ahead and you'll get there.

contrasts.why: Toward is 往, with the step radical 彳 (two slanted strokes). 住 with a single 亻 means to live somewhere.

contrasts.wrong: 他每天下午去公园锻练。

right.zh: 他每天下午去公园锻炼。
right.py: tā měi tiān xià wǔ qù gōng yuán duàn liàn
right.en: He works out in the park every afternoon.

contrasts.why: 锻炼 comes from forging metal, so it takes fire 火: 炼. 练 with silk 纟 is for 练习, practising.

contrasts.wrong: 我想卖一本书送给妈妈。

right.zh: 我想买一本书送给妈妈。
right.py: wǒ xiǎng mǎi yī běn shū sòng gěi mā ma
right.en: I want to buy a book to give to my mum.

contrasts.why: You get a book in order to give it, so it is 买, buy. 卖 has the extra 十 on top: with more, you sell.
竟然 (unexpectedly) is 竟, with 音 (日 in the middle) over 儿. 竞 with 口 in the middle (兄) is for 竞争, compete.

cheat: 已经: half shut 已. 自己: wide open 己. Fully closed 巳 is almost never what you want.
Long line on top: 末 (周末), 士 (护士). Long line at the bottom: 未 (未来), 土.
青 family by meaning: speech 请, water 清, heart 情, sun 晴, eye 睛, rice 精.
Asking? Add a mouth: 哪, 问. Pointing? 那.
Mouth drinks 喝, water is thirst 渴. Fire works out 锻炼, silk practises 练习.
Rest is a person by a tree: 休. Toward is two steps: 往. Live is one person: 住.
More on top sells: 卖. The black crow 乌 has no eye.
